info.title: Entra Sign-In Reports BFF - report reader gate
info.description: IF-6, provided by ST-1 (CMP-2). The gate every report endpoint mounts before its handler (AD-7, ST-1 AC-5 and AC-7): no valid session is 401, a session without the reader role is 403, audited as access-denied, and no report data is returned. The 200 of each report endpoint belongs to the story that serves it; this contract fixes only the gate's answers, shown on the daily report's address.

get.summary: The reader gate's answers on a report endpoint

403.description: The session lacks the reader role (type /problems/forbidden). problem+json carrying only type, title, status and traceId.
